title: Cashier manual - starting the shift
text: Step by step guide for the cashier. Turn on the register, log in with your PIN, count the opening cash fund and type the amount. The screen shows the sale window. Use the keyboard and the barcode scanner, the mouse is not needed. Press F1 for help at any time.

title: Cashier manual - selling and charging
text: How to sell: scan each product barcode, the line appears on the ticket. To change the quantity press the asterisk key and type the number. To charge press F12, choose cash, card or mixed payment, type the amount received and the screen shows the change. The printer prints the ticket and the drawer opens.

title: Cashier manual - customer credit F6
text: Instructions to sell on credit. Press F6, search the customer by name or phone, confirm the credit limit and finish the sale. To receive a payment from a customer press F6 again, select the account and type the amount paid. The system prints a receipt with the new balance.

title: Cashier manual - end of shift cut
text: How to close the register at the end of the shift. Open the cashier menu with F8 and choose cash cut. Count the bills and coins, type the counted cash and confirm. The system compares it with the expected cash and prints the cut ticket. Give the money and the ticket to the manager.

title: Owner manual - importing products from Excel
text: Guide for the owner. Prepare an Excel sheet with barcode, name, department, cost and sale price. Open the admin panel, go to Catalog, choose Import and upload the file. Review the preview, fix the rows marked in red and press confirm to load the products.

title: Butcher counter manual - label scale
text: Instructions for the butcher counter. Select the cut on the label scale by its PLU number, place the meat on the tray and press print. The scale prints a label with a barcode that contains the weight and price. The cashier scans the label and the price per kilo is applied automatically.

title: Installation manual - cash register 1
text: Setup guide for register 1. Check the BIOS, enable power on after outage, install Ubuntu Desktop 24.04, set a fixed IP address, connect by Ethernet cable, install the peripheral agent and open Chromium in kiosk mode. Restart and test the printer, drawer and scanner.

title: Manual - card terminal Mercado Pago Point
text: How to charge with card using the Mercado Pago Point terminal. Choose card payment, the amount is sent to the terminal automatically. Ask the customer to insert or tap the card and wait for approval. If the terminal does not answer, cancel and try again or charge in cash.

title: Manual - what to do if something fails
text: Troubleshooting guide for the cashier. If the printer does not print check the paper roll and the cable. If the screen freezes press F5 to reload, the sale in progress is kept on the server. If there is no internet keep selling, the store works on the local network.

title: Owner manual - backups and restore
text: Instructions to check backups. Every night the server saves an encrypted copy of the database on the USB disk and in the cloud storage. Open the admin panel to see the date of the last backup. To restore follow the steps with the technician and never delete old copies.

title: Daily sales report - October 20
text: Daily report for the manager. Total sales of the day, number of tickets, average ticket and sales by department. Groceries represent 48 percent, butcher counter 31 percent and beverages 21 percent. Register 2 had more tickets during the afternoon peak.

title: Monthly profit and margin report - September
text: Monthly report with revenue, cost of goods sold and gross margin by department. The butcher counter has the highest margin. Sales grew 6 percent compared with August. The report recommends reviewing the price of dairy products where margin decreased.

title: Cash cut differences report
text: Report of the differences found in the cash cuts of the week. Register 1 shows a shortage of 40 pesos on Tuesday and register 2 an overage of 15 pesos on Friday. Each difference is listed with the cashier, date and explanation signed by the manager.

title: Shrinkage and waste report - butcher counter
text: Report of meat shrinkage and waste for the month. Compares the kilos purchased, the kilos sold and the trimming loss of each cut. The yield of beef was 82 percent. The report identifies chicken as the product with the highest waste and suggests smaller orders.

title: Top selling products report
text: Weekly report of the best selling products by units and by revenue. The ranking shows tortillas, soft drinks, eggs and ground beef at the top. It also lists the products with no sales in 30 days so the owner can decide whether to stop buying them.

title: Customer credit balance report
text: Report of accounts receivable from customers with credit. Lists each customer, the current balance, the credit limit and the days since the last payment. Three accounts are overdue more than 30 days and the report recommends suspending new credit for them.

title: Cancellations and audit log report
text: Audit report of cancelled tickets and sensitive actions. Shows who cancelled, when, from which register and the reason. Nothing is deleted from the system, every correction leaves a record. This week there were five cancellations, all authorized by the manager.

title: Incident report - printer outage register 2
text: Incident report. On Saturday the thermal printer of register 2 stopped printing for 20 minutes because of a network cable failure. Sales continued in register 1. The cable was replaced and the cause, duration and solution were documented by the technician.

title: Sales by hour report
text: Analysis report of sales by hour of the day for the last four weeks. The peak is between 6 pm and 8 pm and the lowest activity is between 3 pm and 4 pm. The report recommends opening both registers during the evening peak.

title: Card payment reconciliation report
text: Report that compares the card payments recorded in the system with the deposits from Mercado Pago. All approved payments match except one charge that was approved twice and refunded. The report shows commissions and the net amount received.

title: Sales ticket 000845
text: Ticket number 000845 from register 1. Items: 1 kg ground beef, 2 liters milk, 1 package tortillas, 1 soft drink. Subtotal, total and payment in cash. Amount received 500 pesos, change returned to the customer. Thank you for your purchase at La Nube.

title: Sales ticket 000912 card payment
text: Ticket 000912 from register 2 paid with debit card through the terminal. Items: rice, beans, cooking oil, eggs and detergent. The ticket shows the authorization number and the last four digits of the card. The customer received the printed receipt.

title: Customer invoice request CFDI
text: Request from a customer to receive an electronic invoice for the purchase on ticket 000930. The customer gives the tax ID, business name, postal code and tax regime. The sale amount and the date are attached to generate the invoice.

title: Weekend promotion - two for one in beverages
text: Promotion for customers valid Saturday and Sunday. Buy two soft drinks of 600 ml and pay one. The discount is applied automatically at the register when both items are scanned. Not valid with other offers. Promotional price signs are placed on the fridge.

title: Credit sale to customer Maria Lopez
text: Credit sale recorded for the customer Maria Lopez. Purchase of meat and groceries charged to her account. Previous balance, amount of this purchase and new balance are printed. The customer signs the ticket to accept the charge on her credit account.

title: Mixed payment sale ticket
text: Sale paid with mixed payment. The customer paid part with cash and the rest with card. The ticket shows each payment method, the amount of each one and the total of the purchase. The sale was completed at register 1 during the morning.

title: Refund of a returned product
text: Return of a product by a customer. The yogurt was expired so the cashier refunded the money in cash. A new negative movement was recorded referencing the original ticket. The manager authorized the return with his PIN.

title: Butcher counter sale by weight
text: Sale of meat by weight. The customer bought 1.250 kg of beef steak and 0.800 kg of pork chop. The labels printed by the scale were scanned at the register and the price per kilo was calculated. Total paid with card.

title: Price list for customers - weekly offers
text: List of weekly offers for customers. Discounted prices on eggs, chicken, tortillas and cleaning products. Offers are valid from Monday to Sunday or until stock runs out. Customers can ask the cashier for the printed list.

title: Customer payment to credit account
text: Payment received from a customer to reduce the debt of the credit account. The customer paid 300 pesos in cash. The receipt shows the previous balance, the payment and the new balance. The payment was recorded at register 2.

title: Purchase order to beef supplier
text: Purchase order for the meat supplier. Request 60 kg of beef in quarters and 30 kg of pork for Thursday delivery. Includes agreed cost per kilo, delivery address and contact. The order is recorded to compare it later with the delivery received.

title: Goods receipt - groceries delivery
text: Record of goods received from the grocery distributor. Each product is checked against the purchase order and the invoice. Two boxes of cooking oil arrived damaged and were rejected. The received quantities are added to stock in the system.

title: Physical inventory count - beverages
text: Physical count of the beverage department. The staff counted each product on the shelf and in the warehouse and typed the quantity. The system shows differences between expected and counted stock. Adjustments are recorded with reason and responsible person.

title: Meat breakdown record beef quarter
text: Breakdown of a beef quarter into cuts. The 45 kg quarter produced steak, ground beef, ribs and bones. The weight of each cut and the trimming loss are recorded. The cost of the quarter is distributed among the cuts to update their stock and cost.

title: Low stock alert list
text: List of products below the minimum stock level. Includes milk, eggs, toilet paper and tortillas. For each product it shows current stock, minimum level and suggested quantity to buy. The manager uses this list to prepare the next purchase orders.

title: Supplier catalog and costs - dairy
text: Catalog of the dairy supplier with product codes, presentation, unit cost and delivery days. Prices changed this week for cheese and cream. The cost of the products in the system must be updated to keep the margin.

title: Inventory adjustment for expired products
text: Adjustment of stock for expired products removed from the shelf. Yogurt, ham and bread were discarded. Each product, quantity, cost and reason is recorded. The adjustment creates a new inventory movement and does not delete the original records.

title: Warehouse transfer to store shelves
text: Movement of products from the back warehouse to the sales floor shelves. Lists the products moved, quantities and who did the transfer. Stock is controlled per location to know what is on display and what remains stored.

title: Product catalog new items
text: Registration of new products in the catalog. Each new item has barcode, name, department, unit of measure, cost, sale price and minimum stock. Products sold by weight are marked with kilogram as the unit. Labels for the shelf are printed.

title: Kardex movements for ground beef
text: Kardex of stock movements for ground beef. Shows entries from the breakdown of quarters, exits from sales, waste adjustments and the running balance in kilograms. It helps to trace every change in the stock of the product.

title: Cash handling policy
text: Policy for handling cash in the store. The cash in the drawer must not exceed 3000 pesos, the excess is withdrawn by the manager. Cashiers must not leave the register open and every cash withdrawal must be recorded in the system with signature.

title: Nothing is deleted policy
text: Rule of the organization: sales, payments and inventory movements are never deleted or edited. Errors are corrected with a new cancellation or adjustment movement that records who did it, when and why. This guarantees a complete audit trail.

title: Password and PIN security policy
text: Security policy for users. Each employee has a personal PIN that must not be shared. After several failed attempts the account is locked. Passwords are stored encrypted. The owner reviews the list of active users every month.

title: Customer credit policy
text: Rules to grant credit to customers. Only known customers with address and phone can receive credit. The maximum limit is 1500 pesos. Payments are expected every two weeks. If an account is overdue more than 30 days new credit is suspended.

title: Food safety and hygiene policy butcher counter
text: Hygiene rules for the butcher counter. Staff must wear cap, apron and gloves. Knives and boards are cleaned after each use. Meat is kept below 4 degrees Celsius and the refrigerator temperature is recorded twice a day.

title: Returns and refunds policy
text: Policy for returns. Customers can return products within 24 hours with their ticket. Meat and refrigerated products are not returned except when they are in bad condition. Every refund requires the authorization of the manager.

title: Data backup policy
text: Policy for protecting the information of the store. The database is copied every night, encrypted and stored on a local USB disk and in the cloud. Old backups are kept for 30 days. Backup keys are not allowed to delete files.

title: Opening and closing hours policy
text: Rules for opening and closing the store. The store opens at 7 am and closes at 10 pm. The first employee turns on the server check, the registers and the scale. At closing every register must make its cash cut before leaving.

title: Pricing policy and margins
text: Rules for setting prices. Sale price is calculated from the cost plus a minimum margin by department. Price changes are approved by the owner and recorded with date. Shelf labels must always match the price in the system.

title: Offline operation policy
text: Rule that the store must keep selling without internet. The server is inside the store and the registers connect through the local network. Internet is only used for backups, remote access of the owner and electronic invoices.
